answers.core: As Godot matures, audio is becoming more important. Doppler tracking customizability is standard in other engines. As games get bigger/more complex, and more detailed, substantial effects like speed of sound delay are necessary.
answers.workaround: Doppler tracking "speed of sound" adjustments could be altered with some fairly simple engine modification. Speed of sound delay would could be done in GDScript with substantial effort, but is a valuable feature for larger scale games.

title: Add speed of sound configuration and delay option to audio doppler tracking
